description: Five-turn English session on a payout batch failure: failed step, failure timestamp, items released, limit recomputed under the current runbook, pending items. DISTILL-CANARY-cb17f62b

files.notes/payout-runbook.md:
# Payout batch runbook (v2, effective 2026-09-01)

- The daily payout limit is 50,000.00 GBP and is checked against the batch GROSS
  amount, including fx fees and any in-flight amounts from earlier batches.
- Changelog: the 2026-08-01 sheet (v1) checked the limit against the NET amount;
  it was replaced after the March overrelease review.
- On limit breach the batch aborts after releasing the items already processed;
  pending items stay queued for the manual rerun.
